/**
 * @name Subprocess usage
 * @description Find all calls to subprocess module to check for command injection risks.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-usage
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "spawnl", "spawnle", "spawnlp", "spawnlpe", "spawnv", "spawnve", "spawnvp", "spawnvpe"]).getACall()
select call, "Call to subprocess or os.system found."
findings.hypothesis: Wheel might execute external commands using subprocess or os.system, potentially leading to command injection if arguments are not properly sanitized.

/**
 * @name Insecure temporary file creation
 * @description Creating temporary files with insecure permissions or predictable names can lead to race conditions or information disclosure.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-temp-file
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-377
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember("mktemp").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("tempnam").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("tmpnam").getACall()
  )
select call, "Use of insecure temporary file creation function."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure temporary file creation using mktemp or similar functions.
